text: All-hands recap: our new fleet management product now has a name, *Atlas Fleet Manager*. It will replace Cloud Console over time. Q2 R2 shipments are at 92% of plan, and we're hiring 4 more engineers. Slides: https://wiki.northwind.dev/company/all-hands-2026-05
